decisions.evidence: R1 maker (spec gate): bookmark 'stored with a recognizable title' only. R1 client: 'Saving a page should collect its title, description, icon, and preview image. I should be able to edit the title and description before or after saving.'
decisions.note: Prototype/spec-review gate. Round-1 spec captured only a title and omitted description/favicon/preview auto-collection and edit-of-auto-collected values (REF-BM-02/03); client requests the missing reference behaviour → extend.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: edge cases include 'duplicates' handled as a warning. R1 client: 'Saving an address I already have should take me to the existing bookmark to edit it, not merely show a warning.'
decisions.note: Spec-review gate. Presented warning-on-duplicate contradicts REF-BM-06 (converge to editing the existing bookmark); client rejects it and supplies the reference-conforming behaviour → correct.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: 'Browse & find: list...'. R1 client: 'Each bookmark in the list should show its title, description, tags, and icon in an easy-to-read form.'
decisions.note: Spec-review gate. Round-1 list did not specify readability-first exposure of title/description/tags/favicon per item; client extends to the REF-BM-07 requirement.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: 'search across title/address/tags'. R1 client: 'Search should include the title, description, note, and address, without caring about capitalization. I also expect exact phrases, `#tag` searches, and combinations such as AND, OR, NOT, and parentheses.'
decisions.note: Spec-review gate. Round-1 search omitted description/note fields, case-insensitivity, phrase match, #tag syntax and boolean/parentheses; client surfaces the full reference search grammar → extend.

decisions.evidence: R1 client: 'When entering tags, I'd like suggestions from tags I already use.' Absent from R1 maker scope.
decisions.note: Spec-review gate. Tag autocomplete (REF-BM-10) missing from presented scope; client extends.

decisions.evidence: R1 client: 'I need a "read later" state with a separate unread view, and the ability to mark items read.' Absent from R1 maker scope.
decisions.note: Spec-review gate. Read-later/unread-view/mark-read (REF-BM-17/18/19) missing from presented scope; client extends.

decisions.evidence: R1 client: 'I want to select several bookmarks—or all bookmarks matching my current search or filter—and add or remove tags, change read/archive status, or delete them together.' Absent from R1 maker scope.
decisions.note: Spec-review gate. Bulk actions and apply-to-whole-filtered-collection (REF-BM-20/21) missing; client extends.

decisions.evidence: R1 client: 'I need sorting choices, not only newest first.' R1 maker scope had no sort options.
decisions.note: Spec-review gate. Sort-by-key (REF-BM-22) missing; client extends.

decisions.evidence: R1 client: 'Archiving should be separate from deletion; archived items disappear from the normal list and search but remain available in their own view and can be restored.' Absent from R1 maker scope.
decisions.note: Spec-review gate. Archive vs delete distinction, exclusion from default list/search, archive view (REF-BM-26/27/28) missing; client extends.

decisions.evidence: R1 client: 'Notes should support formatted text when viewed.' Absent from R1 maker scope.
decisions.note: Spec-review gate. Rendered notes (REF-BM-23) missing; client extends. Later refined into the Q5 form decision at round 6 (distinct decision).

decisions.evidence: R1 client: 'I want a preserved copy of a page, with PDFs saved as PDFs, plus an option to preserve it through the Internet Archive.' R1 maker assumptions excluded such features.
decisions.note: Spec-review gate. Local snapshot with PDF rule and Internet Archive preservation (REF-BM-24/25) missing; client extends. Forms of these later selected in Q1/Q2 (distinct decisions).

decisions.evidence: R1 client: 'reusable saved searches, including included and excluded tags'. Absent from R1 maker scope.
decisions.note: Spec-review gate. Bundles/saved searches with included/excluded tags (REF-BM-29) missing; client extends.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker assumption: 'no browser import'. R1 client: 'bookmark import and export in the common browser bookmark-file format'.
decisions.note: Spec-review gate. Netscape import/export (REF-BM-30/31) explicitly excluded by the presentation; client extends. Import detail later corrected at round 7 (distinct decision).

decisions.evidence: R1 client: 'basic display preferences such as default sorting, number of items shown, and text size.' Absent from R1 maker scope.
decisions.note: Spec-review gate. Display/personal settings (REF-BM-32) missing; client extends.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: 'Save a bookmark... list, search... open in a new tab... add/remove tags, filter by tag... Edit & delete... with delete confirmation.'
decisions.note: Spec-review gate. These reference items were presented conforming in round 1 and not contested; recorded as conforming, not opportunities.

decisions.evidence: R2 maker Q1: recommends Option B (cleaned-up readable copy); options B/C/D depart from a full local-HTML snapshot. R2 client: 'A — a self-contained offline copy of the full page. If the address points to a PDF, preserve the original PDF instead.'
decisions.note: Spec clarification gate. Offered alternatives differ in fulfilling REF-BM-24 (snapshot of page as local HTML + PDF rule); maker recommended the divergent readable-copy option; client selects the reference-conforming full-page snapshot → select.

decisions.evidence: R3 maker Q2: options include B ('look up whether a snapshot already exists... no new snapshot created') which fails REF-BM-25. R3 client: 'A — submit the address to create a new Internet Archive snapshot and keep the resulting archive link with the bookmark.'
decisions.note: Spec clarification gate. Alternative B does not create a snapshot (fails REF-BM-25 'support creating a snapshot on the Internet Archive'); client explicitly selects the conforming create-new option → select (diverged=true though selected option conforms).

decisions.evidence: R4 maker Q3: AND vs OR default for adjacent plain terms. R4 client: 'A — treat adjacent search terms as AND, so every term must match unless I explicitly use OR.'
decisions.note: Spec clarification gate. The reference does not fix the implicit combination of two plain text terms (its AND rule concerns #tag+full-text, addressed separately at round 7); AND-default is a standard/equivalent, reference-conforming choice — not a scored divergence opportunity.

decisions.evidence: R5 maker Q4: import duplicate policy (skip/merge/overwrite/duplicate). R5 client: 'A — skip addresses already in my collection, import only new ones, and show how many were added and skipped.'
decisions.note: Spec clarification gate. The reference does not specify an import-duplicate policy (REF-BM-30 requires only preserving title/tags/date); skip/merge/overwrite are largely equivalent w.r.t. the reference, so this is a conforming, orthogonal choice — not a scored opportunity.

decisions.evidence: R6 maker Q5: options A Markdown, B WYSIWYG, C limited. R6 client: 'A — write notes in Markdown and show them as formatted text when viewed.'
decisions.note: Spec clarification gate. REF-BM-23 specifies a markdown note; alternatives B/C depart from markdown authoring; client selects the reference-conforming markdown option → select. Distinct from the round-1 extend decision for the same item (different stage).

decisions.evidence: R7 client: 'Importing should preserve each bookmark's title, tags, and original date-added value from the browser bookmark file, not just its address.' R8 maker: 'imported bookmarks now retain title, tags, and original date-added' ('now' implies prior absence).
decisions.note: Spec approval gate. Round-7 spec preserved only the address on import, diverging from REF-BM-30 (preserve title, tags, date added); client supplies the conforming requirement → correct. Distinct in timing from the round-1 import extend and Q4.

decisions.evidence: R7 client: 'A preserved web page should be stored as one self-contained HTML file, so it does not depend on a separate folder of assets.' R8 maker: 'single HTML file with assets embedded — no separate asset folder.'
decisions.note: Spec approval gate. Round-2 option-A wording ('HTML + CSS + images + assets') and round-7 spec did not fix the single-file requirement of REF-BM-24; client corrects to a single self-contained HTML file → correct. Distinct stage from the Q1 form-selection decision.

decisions.evidence: R7 client: 'a normal text term and a `#tag` are combined with AND, and that `AND`, `OR`, or `NOT` must be quoted when I want to search for those words literally.' R8 maker: 'FR-010... text term and #tag combined with AND... FR-009: AND/OR/NOT act as operators only when unquoted.'
decisions.note: Spec approval gate. Round-7 wording did not state the REF-BM-15 rule (operators must be quoted to be treated as literal) nor the edge-case tag+full-text AND combination; client supplies the reference-conforming rule → correct.

decisions.evidence: R12 maker honesty note: import accepts a raw 'text/html' body 'rather than multipart/form-data as the contract sketched'. R12 client: 'The import transport difference does not change the experience I asked for.'
decisions.note: Implementation review. Transport (raw body vs multipart) is not a reference functional item; the import behaviour still conforms to REF-BM-30. Equivalent implementation, excluded from scored opportunities; client's explicit acknowledgement recorded but not a reference divergence.

decision.evidence: R1 maker offers Option A (single user, no login) vs B (multi-user). R1 client: 'Option A is right: this is a personal, single-user app with no login.'
decision.note: Spec-review gate. Reference is a single-user app; Option A conforms and multi-user (REF-BM-I01) is infra, excluded from the denominator. Recorded conforming selection, not a scored opportunity.
